description: Default AGNI-SCAN verification-priority heuristic. Weights are expert-set defaults, not fitted or validated. The score ranks cells for field verification; it is NOT a probability of burning.

components.name: observed_detections
components.description: VIIRS detections in the analysis window; 5 or more saturates the component.

components.name: historical_recurrence
components.description: Recurrence across earlier seasons (calendar years before the window): each season's VIIRS detections are capped at 5, then averaged over the seasons covered, so no single active season dominates.

components.name: cropland_fraction
components.description: Share of the cell under paddy/cropland (0-1), supplied per cell_id from an authoritative land-cover product.
